verdict.rationale: Swell's changelog documents Apple Pay support, but only for subscriptions via Braintree. That is a thin, scoped first-party wallet capability. The PayPal entry covers direct card payments through the PayPal gateway, not the PayPal wallet, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: Google Pay support, PayPal wallet checkout, platform one-click/saved-details checkout, Apple Pay for one-time purchases, in-depth docs and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can pay with accelerated wallets — Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, platform one-click — without re-entering details

citations.quote: Added Apple Pay support for subscriptions via Braintree.
